---
title: "About"
---

This site is the example for three Quarto 2 features that were designed
to work together: a listing declared as `type: metadata`, an `{lmd}` cell
that builds the page from the listing's items, and a React component that
filters the same items in the browser.

See the [posts](index.qmd) page and the `README.md` next to this file.
